statistics.denominator: all N centroids in W, including distances > rmax
statistics.rmax_rationale: 5 um fits field sizes; erosion of A protects unknown boundaries and black void context; 0.25 um grid exceeds coarsest pixel spacing 0.1126 um. Fixed before computing any CDF or p.

sensitivity.rationale: One-pixel target boundary perturbation is a numerical probe, not a validated error interval. Residual thresholds 9/12 span visibly diffuse dark margins. Bright thresholds 225/235/245 bracket unsaturated to saturated cores. 0.05 um2 probes very small unresolved objects. A further 1 um erosion checks the prominent unknown void/fracture context. No thresholds selected using p.
